snippet.title: Misc Mechanics - TR4SH Rebuffed S Tutorials
snippet.description:
Loads of miscellaneous mechanics, major move differences, etc.

This video was recorded using v1.7, so mechanics added in v1.8 or later (such as pacman's elemental hydrants) are not included.

Video edited by AKA7

Join the TR4SH discord server here:
https://discord.gg/Bh7pTDf

you can download tr4sh here:
https://gamebanana.com/mods/372158
